name: button-lever
comment: A standing player on the stone platform right-clicks (use_item with an empty hand: BlockLever / BlockButton / BlockRedstoneRepeater.blockActivated through PlayerController.sendPlaceBlock). A floor lever (69, meta 5) at (2, 61, 0) with wire at x = 3, 4: on at t = 1, off at t = 10, on at t = 30. A stone button (77, meta 1: on the stone block at x = -2) at (-1, 61, 0) with wire at (-1, 61, 1): pressed at t = 3 (tick in 20: BlockButton.updateTick releases it at t = 23), pressed again at t = 5 (already pressed: no change, still true), and at t = 33. A repeater (93, meta 1) at (0, 61, 3): delay cycled at t = 7, 8, 9, 11 (wraps to 0). power dumps on the block the button hangs on (strong power), the block under the lever, and the wires; scheduled_ticks full each tick. ray_trace every tick down onto the lever and along -x into the button: Block.collisionRayTrace runs setBlockBoundsBasedOnState (BlockLever / BlockButton; the button is thinner while pressed).
